case_horizon: bounded visible event, not full parent turn; client/deal correspondence excluded; tool results and previous context absent
gold_universe: 199 current active full statements, pinned in rule-texts.json; historical committed210rule roster is not used
harness_notes: load_cases preserves judged_rules, unjudged_rules, disputed and gold; do not drop these fields when scoring.
Filter headline_eligible before score; load_cases drops that custom field, so filter raw JSONL first or retain an external ID allowlist.
No future tool calls, stratum, category, label_scope, source hashes or gold fields may enter selector state. Pass only prompt and the current tool input.
The official fixed synthetic train168/test72 are untouched. The real train has121eligible tool events plus2diagnostic human fragments. The real test has40eligible events,1user/39tool, in29sessions.
Do not silently pool this event-level diagnostic with the original whole-turn benchmark. Report real heldout as a separate limited external check.
A checkpoint must pin candidate source/config digests before opening the heldout file. Final test scoring happens once; no retuning on its examples.
Use no Jev, paid API, production log, or record mutation for replay. This preparation made zero model calls.
label_sources: frozen live standing-context full statements in rule-texts.json
individual transcript row hashes and line numbers in each case
limits: 160tool events and3human prompts are an engineering/governance sample, not a representative client-turn corpus.
Earlier human intent, tool results, assistant prose, and later actions were excluded. Gold is bounded-action; contextual conditions are explicitly disputed.
Two context-poor human prompts are diagnostic-only and excluded from headline scoring.
The existing four universal partner-prose labels are retained as an explicit top-level-session audience assumption.
Independent label audit remains required before claiming product-wide real-turn precision.
ordered_label_questions: 1. Is the source a recent top-level CARR session and the exact prompt/input safe under the whitelist? Exclude results, assistant prose, sidechains, unfamiliar names, credentials and arbitrary JSON.
2. What exact action is visible now? A tool input is one event; missing earlier intent and later tool calls are not supplied to the selector or invented by the labeler.
3. Does the full rule name a trigger that this visible action satisfies? If yes, gold with a rationale and frozen statement hash. A filename or tool substring alone does not prove a topic action.
4. Does applicability require an earlier prompt, later reply, repetition, recipient, claimed result, or coding scope? If missing, disputed. Do not count disputed as irrelevant.
5. Does the four-rule universal partner-prose policy apply? The top-level non-sidechain audience assumption is written explicitly; session-opening recitation is not inferred from a read call.
6. If the trigger requires a different action and the bounded input carries no such trigger, not. A partial human fragment receives only universal judgments and is diagnostic-only.
privacy_review: All selected source filenames are control/source filenames without client names. Commands have strict read-only grammars; opaque record IDs reveal no record body. Only3human prompts survive vocabulary checks.
reproduction_commands: apply the fixed sampling quotas/order above, then use the written action review; transcript row_sha256 permits a later read-only provenance check even if transcripts append
sampling_order_within_category: ascending timestamp then case ID; at most4events/session; at most1category/session except2source reads; at most2events per source path; no selector results used
split_freeze: session hash assigned before cases are selected or labeled; separate train.jsonl and heldout.sealed.jsonl; tuner may read train only
